summary: Server one-frame event entity of esv::profile::ManagementSystem: one per (user, profile setting) change queued in the system's HashMap<net::UserID, HashMap<FixedString, UpdateData>>; ProcessUpdateRequests creates a fresh entity with this component for each pair and ClearOneFrameComponents removes them. Read by esv::notification::System. Seen.py context: appears during dialogues, fights, jumps, events and explorations - i.e. whenever the player's profile flags change (one holder at a time).

fields.name: User
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x8168A0 ProcessUpdateRequests copies the outer map key (net::UserID, 4 bytes; macOS: ls::HashMap<net::UserID, ls::HashMap<ls::FixedString, esv::profile::ManagementSystem::UpdateData>>) to +0. bg3.exe+0x2F377A0 default: a global (invalid user id). Live: always 0x10001 (user 1).

fields.name: Key
fields.evidence: FixedString::operator= from the inner map key (the profile setting name). Default 0xFFFFFFFF (null FixedString).

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: Copied from UpdateData byte 0 when its byte 1 is set (ls::Optional<bool> assignment). Live: 1.

fields.name: HasValue
fields.evidence: Set to 1 together with Value (Optional engaged flag); default 0 in bg3.exe+0x2F377A0. Live: 1.

open_questions: Name of the FixedString (which profile setting) and whether +8/+9 are an ls::Optional<bool> (likely).
